learning_outcomes.text: Approach the reality of underdevelopment and marginalization.

Acquire a global and supportive vision of reality, complementing conventional technical education to achieve comprehensive training that includes the ethical principles that should govern professional practice.
Acquire specific professional training in the field of technological cooperation and development.
Participate in a debate forum on technical cooperation and development at the University of Oviedo.
Students with greater critical sense, respect for diversity, and capacity for participation in social activities.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, and critical reasoning.
Ability to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and aptitudes in the field of Engineering, both orally and in writing, and to all types of audiences.
Ability to analyze and evaluate the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.
Ability to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.
Ability to know, select, criticize, and use diverse sources of information.
Ability to work in a team.
Approach the reality of underdevelopment and marginalization.

Acquire a global and supportive vision of reality, complementing conventional technical education to provide students with comprehensive training that includes the ethical principles that should govern their professional practice.
Acquire specific professional training in the field of technological cooperation and development.
Participate in a debate forum on technical cooperation and development at the University of Oviedo.
Put into practice critical thinking, respect for diversity, and the capacity to participate in social activities.

Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and aptitudes, understanding the ethical and professional responsibility of the activity of the Telecommunication Technical Engineer.
Ability to analyze and evaluate the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.

Ability to work in a multidisciplinary group and in a multilingual environment and to communicate, both in writing and orally, knowledge, procedures, results, and ideas related to telecommunications and electronics.

syllabus_topics: Cooperation for development: methods and agents.
Infrastructure, construction, and materials technologies in cooperation for development.
Energy technologies in cooperation for development.
Cooperation for development projects based on energy supply to rural communities and other disadvantaged groups.
Information technologies in cooperation for development.
Digital policy: digital divides; biases in design and use; new rights and properties; ICT as agents of change and social control.
Environmental technologies in cooperation for development.
Atmospheric pollution: impacts of climate change.

assessment_methods.method: Final exam (report and verbal presentation on a group sensitization project)

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, a minimum of 75% attendance is required to be evaluated, otherwise the grade will be 'Not Presented'. The final grade is calculated as: FINAL GRADE = EX_FIN x 0.3 + (P1 + P2 + P3 + P4 + P5 + P6) x 0.1 + A x 0.05 + PA x 0.05. A score of at least 5 points is needed to pass. For extraordinary calls, the final grade is calculated as: FINAL GRADE = EX_EXTRA x 0.4 + (P1 + P2 + P3 + P4 + P5 + P6) x 0.1. Students must inform the faculty at least 4 weeks in advance of their intention to take the extraordinary exam and submit project reports and practice tasks at least 48 hours before the exam.
